items.label: Confirm LAANC / controlled-airspace authorization
items.note: Scenario sets laanc_required=true; verify authorization evidence, flight window, altitude limits, and operating area outside ORBITAL.

items.label: Confirm waiver / authorization coverage
items.note: Scenario indicates a waiver or authorization is required; verify document scope, dates, conditions, and mission fit outside ORBITAL.

items.label: Confirm visual observer assignment
items.note: Assign visual observer coverage, station locations, communications, handoff rules, and responsibilities before dispatch.

items.label: Confirm crew briefing completed
items.note: Brief route, roles, communications, geofences, weather, abort criteria, lost-link procedures, and final go/no-go authority.

items.label: Confirm emergency / contingency plan
items.note: Review lost-link response, diversion or landing zones, flyaway response, incident contacts, and recovery responsibilities.

items.label: Confirm NOTAM / local restriction review
items.note: Review current NOTAMs, TFRs, local restrictions, site permissions, and customer constraints close to flight time.

items.label: Confirm weather minimums
items.note: Confirm launch-time weather and operator minimums, including wind, gusts, visibility, precipitation, and temperature, before flight. Current planning weather: source offline Open-Meteo-shaped sample; timestamp 2026-09-11T16:00:00Z; wind 4.5 m/s; gust 5.9 m/s.

items.label: Confirm battery reserve
items.note: Confirm launch battery, reserve policy, payload draw, and abort reserve meet operator requirements before release (required reserve 700.0 Wh; planned final battery 832.1 Wh; modeled reserve margin 132.1 Wh).
